questions.subject: physics
questions.content: A disc with a flat small bottom beaker placed on it at a distance R from its center is revolving about an axis passing through the center and perpendicular to its plane with an angular velocity . The coefficient of static friction between the bottom of the beaker and the surface of the disc is . The beaker will revolve with the disc if :
